arc_assessment: The sequence tells the story it promises. The 01 hook (a say on 5 megawatts, by September 30th) is paid immediately by 02 (where the site is), and 09 lands on the one ask that 01 set up. The middle sags: 03 to 04 and 06 to 07 close their loops on administrative facts rather than open new ones, and 06 to 08 is three dense frames about a process the reader can't act on, so the argument escalates on paper more than it does in the thumbs.

junction_pulls.pull: 'a say on 5 megawatts' plus the runway light row: which reactor, where on the base?
the dashed gold ring THE SITE, AS DESCRIBED and 'near wetlands': show me the ground
'Clear it, dig it, fill it, level it' asks for whom, but the body ends on the draft date and plants nothing
nothing on 04 hints at a second process; 05 works as a surprise
LAND FOR AI DATA CENTERS. raises which land, and 06 answers it
06 closes on no award and a solicitation number; only the forget-me-not collars carry forward
the open chevron suggests bigger than this, but the guard line closes the frame
the counter at 08 / 09 and 'we have completely lost our way' leave the reader wanting an action

continuity_findings.problem: the snow clock runs backwards: 01's tussocks carry the heaviest caps in the deck
continuity_findings.fix: cut 01's caps to a noise-thresholded dusting; the heaviest accumulation belongs to 09

continuity_findings.problem: the plan promises one warm gold peak on 09; the render is the coldest ground in the deck and the gold is a hairline
continuity_findings.fix: make the slot a gold emitter spilling warm light on the cap underside and a small pool on the snow in front

continuity_findings.problem: three frames share one scratch-stroke snow floor
caps on the fixtures are not readable
continuity_findings.fix: a lit cap on the near fixture head

rhythm_findings.problem: three dense frames in a row, none about the reader's own door
rhythm_findings.fix: lighten 08 and let the engraved terrain take the space

rhythm_findings.problem: three dense frames before the breather, eased because 02 is mostly image
the breather lands where planned and works

consistency_findings.problem: counters and slugs transcribed, all increment correctly; Polaris, wordmark and fixtures in the same places
mesh runs through the alaskaaihq.com fixture
consistency_findings.fix: knock the mesh out behind the fixture

consistency_findings.problem: the #46545F coordinates fixture nearly disappears into lit snow
consistency_findings.fix: night ink fixtures on lit-ground frames

consistency_findings.problem: some tussock shadow shapes read as a key from the right
assemble reported stale at the time of review; the critic judged from the full renders
palette holds; red only on runway end lights; gold and forget-me-not only on their declared meanings

predicted_bail_point.why: after the breather 06 pivots to a process the reader has no door into and plants nothing forward
predicted_bail_point.fix: end 06 on a forward line or lighten 08 so the run to the ask is plant, pay, short, ask

weakest_frames.problem: the engraved hills are a thin skyline band, a black strip below, the lower third flat
weakest_frames.fix: run the engraved terrain full-bleed from about y 1000 to the bottom, near ridge two to three times taller, dense hatching

weakest_frames.problem: the 20-block row, the largest object, is the least modelled; a flat lower band with a hard seam
weakest_frames.fix: model row C as a material with steel grain, raised caps with a lit rim and lee, visible casts, carry the shelf falloff down

weakest_frames.problem: ruler-straight horizon seam, uniform berm band, dark scratch texture with no event, plain posts
weakest_frames.fix: model the ploughed berm as ridges with lit windward faces and lees, fog the seam into a treeline

weakest_frames.problem: tussocks read as smooth white domes; the near foreground is an eventless defocus
weakest_frames.fix: break the caps to a dusting; give the near band its own events

weakest_frames.problem: the flipped floor reads as horizontal scratch stripes; tapes are flat fills
weakest_frames.fix: carved-ridge shading instead of scratches; half-bury the near tapes

weakest_frames.problem: the snowbank is a flat gradient polygon; the lower-left pavement is uniform noise
weakest_frames.fix: more fixtures stepping into the fog with capped heads

cross_frame.problem: one AKSNOW floor with the same scratch strokes on three adjacent frames
the helper's scratch strokes read as cracks or stripes; 05 has a free-standing dark line and the mesh ends abruptly
cross_frame.fix: lower stroke contrast; fix 05's rail shadow and far mesh

cross_frame.problem: 06 was to be the darkest frame and is mid-key; 09 was to be the warm peak and is the coldest
cross_frame.fix: 09 slot spill; drop 06's ground key about 30 percent

cross_frame.problem: the masterful depth frame is claimed more than earned
